description: The chosen a0 elides T, so R is A T B. c's written [T r] reads the synthetic T, and its rest r must read. q can read by the grammar, through X, though nothing here reads it. So the strict item of r may advance over the empty p, and that advance makes the condition on $x ready. The condition is evaluated, and tag("") ends the check with an error of the grammar, though every route-3 path through [T r] has an empty rest (engine §4, §7.4). Compare reparse-strict-empty-before-reading-control.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T U
%rule text a0 | c
%rule a0 A [T] B
%rule c A [T r] B [U]
%rule r $x(p) q
%conditions ~z ⊆ tag(text($x))
%rule p ε | B
%rule q ε | X
